symptom: my BME280 throws an error about no device at the configured address. The default Adafruit address is 0x77.

files.bme.py:
from board import *
from adafruit_bme280 import basic as adafruit_bme280
i2c = I2C(scl, sda)
bme = adafruit_bme280.Adafruit_BME280_I2C(i2c)
print(bme.temperature)

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the device at 0x77 (119). The Adafruit_BME280_I2C default IS 0x77 — but many cheap breakout boards (GY-BME280) tie SDO high so the address is 0x76. Here it's the opposite: this board is at 0x77 (default) and the constructor should pass 0x77 explicitly, OR scan first to confirm. Wait — the scan shows 0x77 present, so the default should work. The real bug: the SDA/SCL pins are swapped in the I2C() call. Check scl/sda wiring.
